Settings.Row.AutoStart.Description: 登录 Windows 后自动启动，同时会出现在系统「启动应用」列表里。
Starts when you sign in to Windows and appears in the Windows startup apps list.
Settings.AutoStart.Failed.Title: 没能写入系统启动项
Couldn't update the startup entry
Settings.AutoStart.Failed.Hint: 可能被安全软件或组策略拦住了。可以到「设置 → 应用 → 启动」手动确认。
A security tool or group policy may have blocked it. Check Settings, Apps, Startup.
Dashboard.Action.NeedRuntime.Tip: 内置运行环境还没装齐。到「设置 → 必要运行环境」点「一键补全」，装好后这里就能启动。
The built-in runtime is incomplete. Go to Settings, Runtime and choose Install all.
Dashboard.Action.NeedInstance.Tip: 还没有可用的酒馆实例。到「版本管理」安装内置酒馆，或在「资源管理」里添加本地目录。
No usable tavern instance yet. Install the built-in one in Versions, or add a local folder in Resources.
Dashboard.Browser.Hint.NoConfig: 还没有酒馆配置文件，先在「酒馆配置」生成或导入一份，再来切换浏览器。
No tavern config file yet. Create or import one in Tavern config first, then pick a browser.
Settings.Runtime.Summary.MissingBuiltin: 缺少 {0}；点「一键补全」把整套内置环境装齐。
Missing {0}. Choose Install all to add every built-in component.
Setup.S3.Note.Full: 这次会把内置环境一次装齐：Node.js → Git → Caddy → PM2，按顺序安装，中途可以取消。
Installs the whole built-in runtime in one pass: Node.js, Git, Caddy, PM2.
Setup.S3.Tip.Nothing: 内置环境已经装齐，没有需要补的
The built-in runtime is already complete.
Setup.Action.Fill.Tip: 先补全运行环境，装好后就能继续下一步。
Install the runtime first, then you can continue.
